units.source_text: 我转身走下石阶，嘴里不停地念叨"十四……十四……"

en.t: I turned and went down the stone steps, endlessly muttering "fourteen... fourteen..." under my breath.

units.source_text: 我觉得这数字的声音仿佛停滞在我的舌头上，

en.t: I felt as though the sound of that number had come to a halt on my tongue,
as if it were gradually bringing forth some meaning.
